title: Realized tower purity has the integral projection-counit adjunct
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in the fixed algebraic closure [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. On the small pro-etale sites put $R_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\lim_n(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_W$, $\mathbf1_W=R_W$, and $A_{n,W}=(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_W$ for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. Use $D^b_{ctf}(W,\mathcal O_E)$, the derived-complete constructible category with one common finite Tor interval for all reductions [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], its completed pullback and tensor [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], and its twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Write $r_W=\operatorname{red}_W$ for simultaneous derived reduction to actual coefficient towers. Fix a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], put $P=Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and let $G=Rf^!_{\mathcal O_E}$ have its specified adjunction $P\dashv G$ and counit $\epsilon$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Let $H=R\lim f^!_\bullet r_Y$ have the realized tower adjunction and reduction comparisons of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection], and let $\delta:H\xrightarrow{\sim}G$ be the unique counit-preserving comparison [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint]. Set $T=\mathbf1_X(d)[2d]$.

Use the fixed-compactification projection maps of [def-exchange-projection], assumed invertible on the displayed finite-Tor inputs, and the canonical realization comparisons of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ let
$$\Gamma_K=\delta_K\circ R\lim\bigl(\gamma_{f,\bullet}(r_YK)\bigr):Lf^*K(d)[2d]\longrightarrow GK,$$
using the source realization and the diagonal tower orientation and tensor transpose of [det-sp-tower-gamma]. Put $a=\Gamma_{\mathbf1_Y}:T\to G\mathbf1_Y$. The maps $\Gamma_K$ are natural isomorphisms. Their finite reductions, with the specified reduction comparisons, are precisely the finite purity maps of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map]; this includes $a$ at the unit. These assertions hold also at uniformizer-power levels under the canonical cofinal comparison with the $\ell$-power levels.

Write $\omega=G\mathbf1_Y$, let $\Pi_{K,T}:P(Lf^*K\widehat\otimes^LT)\xrightarrow{\sim}K\widehat\otimes^LPT$ and $\Pi_{K,\omega}$ be inverse projection maps with tensor symmetries, and let $\sigma_K:Lf^*K(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf^*K\widehat\otimes^LT$ be twist reassociation. In the integral derived category the counit adjunct satisfies
$$\begin{aligned}
\epsilon_K\circ P(\Gamma_K)&=(1_K\widehat\otimes\epsilon_{\mathbf1_Y})\circ\Pi_{K,\omega}\circ P(1\widehat\otimes a)\circ P(\sigma_K)\\
&=(1_K\widehat\otimes(\epsilon_{\mathbf1_Y}\circ P(a)))\circ\Pi_{K,T}\circ P(\sigma_K).
\end{aligned}$$
All unit constraints are understood. The first equality uses the specified realized tower projection and counit maps, and holds before passage to any finite-level evaluations.
